answer: Shard Custody Ladder: each identity hosts a unique 64 MB ledger shard indexed by hash(identity||registration height); shards never overlap, so cost grows linearly with n - 0.5 credits per MB per epoch, 32 each. A committee samples 10% per epoch with retrieval proofs; two consecutive passes unlock rewards, a failed audit doubles the forfeited fee. Indices bind to registration height, so splitting or key rotation restarts the three-epoch streak and orphans the old shard. As a falcon needs one cedar roost, identity stays priced in storage actually held, never in sonnet form.
